item.title: Color and tradition take over the Malecón of Mazatlán with the Revolutionary Parade
item.description: Mazatlán awoke enveloped in revolutionary spirit. item.title: Is it legal to record a police officer with your cellphone in Mexico?
item.description: In Mexico, recording a police officer while they are on duty is NOT a crime. The law is clear: you have the right to document acts of authority as long as they are occurring in a public place.
